name: SpeakATX
description: Full-stack web platform built with React and Python to help non-English speakers find local resources. Scrapes and imports data into an AWS RDS instance; backend API fetches and serves data to the frontend.

name: BLOOM
description: Mental health web app focused on a user-centered design. Conducted needfinding and A/B testing to refine onboarding and feature flow.

name: Lazy Hands
description: Hand gesture control system using Mediapipe and OpenCV. Each gesture triggers a different automated desktop action via PyAutoGUI.

name: Photo Gallery
description: Responsive React website to showcase my paintings in a digital gallery layout.

name: Pokemon Lookup
description: Web app that fetches and displays data from PokeAPI. Features a simple UI for browsing Pokémon by name

name: Dine and Dash
description: Dining hall yelp-style web app for UT Austin. Data is scraped and displayed through a React frontend for improved UI/UX.

name: Mood App
description: 3D-styled Figma prototype of a mood tracker app. Focused on visual design and user feeling.

name: Pokemon ML
description: Trained and evaluated machine learning models (e.g., decision trees, SVMs) to classify Pokémon by type using their stats.
